transcription.text: In 1 Corinthians 16 verses 19 to 20, Paul writes,
"Don't you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit
who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,
for you were bought at a price. So glorify God with your body."
You know, our bodies are the actual temple
of the Holy Spirit of God. And because of that fact alone,
our bodies are worthy of our respect and good stewardship.
What we do with our bodies and what we do to our bodies really is important.
And it does matter to God. In fact, in Romans chapter 12 verse 1,
the Apostle Paul writes, "Therefore, brothers and sisters, in view of the mercies of God,
I urge you to present your bodies as a living sacrifice,
holy and pleasing to God. This is your true worship."
So according to Paul, the right response to what Jesus has done for us
is to actively dedicate our entire physical self
to God's purposes. What we do with our bodies...
